newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Perdigao still a buy.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a report that it was maintaining its buy recommendation on Brazilian meat producer Perdigao's preferred share with a six-to-nine month price target of $2.00.
-- But the bank said it was cutting earnings estimates for Perdigao to 6.6 million reais for 1996 and 21.3 million reais for 1997.
-- It cited slow growth in consumer demand, rising costs and poorer-than-expected financial performance as the firm increases debts to fund added capital expenses.
-- Credit said Perdigao's high-value-added product mix, lean structure and aggressive export strategy have allowed it to suffer les than its competitors from higher grain prices.
-- "These strong fundamentals lead us to view Perdigao as a prime play on the Brazilian meats sector," it said.
-- Increases in its output capacity have enabled Perdigao to raise its market share to 19.2 percent (17.7 pecent for frozen products), the bank said.
-- With plans for capacity and distribution increases, Perdigao is expected to grow more rapidly than the sector and boost market share, it added.
-- "As Perdigao increases its processed meats capacity, the company will be able to grow more rapidly than market leader Sadia," it said, adding Perdigao is now operating at 100 percent of capacity.
-- Perdigao's preferred share was off 0.08 reais at 1.70 reais at 1729 local/1529 EDT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
